lines.text: Once you have a few notes, finding the right one should take a second. Here's how.
lines.source_text: Once you have a few notes, finding the right one should take a second. Here's how.

lines.text: Press Command K, or click Search, to open the command palette.
lines.source_text: Press Command K, or click Search, to open the command palette.

lines.text: Before you type anything, it lists your most recent notes.
lines.source_text: Before you type anything, it lists your most recent notes.

lines.text: Type any word. Tidepool searches titles, text and tags at once.
lines.source_text: Type any word. Tidepool searches titles, text and tags at once.

lines.text: Matches are highlighted, and the best one comes first.
lines.source_text: Matches are highlighted, and the best one comes first.

lines.text: Use the arrow keys to choose a result, then press Enter to open it.
lines.source_text: Use the arrow keys to choose a result, then press Enter to open it.

lines.text: Start with a hash sign, and the palette lists your tags instead.
lines.source_text: Start with a hash sign, and the palette lists your tags instead.

lines.text: Press Enter, and the list shows only the notes with that tag.
lines.source_text: Press Enter, and the list shows only the notes with that tag.

lines.text: With the list in focus, J and K step through the notes. No mouse needed.
lines.source_text: With the list in focus, J and K step through the notes. No mouse needed.

lines.text: To narrow it further, type in Filter this list. Escape clears it again.
lines.source_text: To narrow it further, type in Filter this list. Escape clears it again.

lines.text: The sidebar works too. Click any notebook or tag to filter with one click.
lines.source_text: The sidebar works too. Click any notebook or tag to filter with one click.

lines.text: Finally, a greater-than sign turns search into commands. Let's try dark mode.
lines.source_text: Finally, a greater-than sign turns search into commands. Let's try dark mode.

lines.text: Every note, tag and command is one shortcut away.
lines.source_text: Every note, tag and command is one shortcut away.

lines.text: So: Command K searches everything, a hash jumps to tags, and greater-than runs commands.
lines.source_text: So: Command K searches everything, a hash jumps to tags, and greater-than runs commands.

lines.text: Your notes stay on your device, and now they're easy to find.
